summary: Comprehensive backend smoke test of Verianth Universe portal. 38/38 checks passed across auth, roles, settings, members (verify/role/APP hidden), transactions, announcements, targets, agenda, feedback (anonymous masking), kas upsert idempotency, and profile update. Sessions simulated via direct MongoDB insert with Bearer tokens.
passed: Bearer-token auth resolves owner as is_admin=true & verified=true
Roles CRUD works; system role DELETE returns 400
PUT /api/settings admin OK; non-admin (unverified pending) -> 403; changes reflected
Transactions POST admin OK; non-admin -> 403; /finance/summary computes saldo/pemasukan/pengeluaran correctly (200000/400000/200000)
Announcements CRUD; verified user can GET
Feedback: anonymous masked as 'Anonim' for non-admin; admin sees real author; reply & delete work
Kas upsert on same (user,year,month) updates instead of duplicating (single entry with new amount)
observations: Server-side /api/kas/{year} returns all kas entries and does NOT filter out APP-role users. Requirement expected APP exclusion at API layer. Currently filtering must be done client-side by cross-referencing /api/members. Consider filtering server-side for consistency. Priority: LOW.
action_items: Optional: filter APP-role users from GET /api/kas/{year} response to match spec
